hook: Single neurons in speech motor cortex carry information about sentence structure and meaning.
summary: Neurons in speech motor cortex carry signals about how sentences are built, not just the sounds and movements of speech. Implanted electrode arrays in three BrainGate2 participants recorded activity during sentences, word lists, and nonword versions of each, and the stimulus type could be decoded. Semantic categories were decodable in two larger datasets. Only three people took part in the main task, all with implants for clinical reasons.
title: Sentence-level neural dynamics in speech motor cortex
